_comment: Slyburn track-layout spec. EDIT THIS to match your actual audio spec — categories, keywords, and track mapping are all data, nothing is hardcoded in the script. Replace with the real show spec and rename to track_spec.json.

DX.description: Dialogue: sit-down interview audio, narration/VO, scratch VO.

SOT.description: Sync/verite sound-on-tape: field audio married to picture, presser audio, on-the-fly comments backstage or in rehearsal.

PERF.description: Live musical performance recordings: recital, concerto, competition rounds, piano performance audio (board feeds, hall mics).

NAT.description: Natural sound and ambience: room tone, crowd, applause beds, atmospheres, exteriors.

SFX.description: Sound effects and design elements: whooshes, risers, hits, transitions, designed sweeteners.

MX.description: Music score and needle drops used AS SCORE (not performance sync): library cues, composed score, licensed tracks.

BROLL.description: B-roll, verite coverage, performance coverage shot for this film.

ARCHIVAL.description: Archival footage, stills, scans, newsreel, licensed historical material.

GFX.description: Graphics, titles, lower thirds, maps, animations.

path_hints._comment: Folder-name fragments (matched against the media path) that are a STRONG signal, checked before name keywords.

extension_hints._comment: Extensions that lean a category when nothing else matches. Video extensions are ignored for audio clips and vice versa.
